summary: Inspected all retained derived-responsive screenshots and probes at 375, 390, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440px. The checkout options stack at 375/390/768 and return to three columns at 1024/1280/1440; fonts are ready at every width. The route-owned section stays within the viewport at every retained width. The document probe reports 1px overflow only at 375px, but the checkout section itself spans x=20 to x=355 and is not the overflowing owner.
issues: CHK-RESP-LOGIN-001 | high | login action layout at intermediate width | Expected: the primary login action and password-recovery control remain distinct, readable and non-overlapping at every retained width. Actual: in responsive-1024.png the green login button overlaps the left side of the outlined password-recovery control and obscures the start of its label; at 375px the two controls also meet without a safe gap. Fix: add an explicit responsive gap/stacking rule for the login action row before the controls collide, while preserving the source labels and native controls.
